import { DemoPlayer } from './src/components/DemoPlayer.js'; // Generate unique session ID for this landing page instance const sessionId = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10); const demoDocId = `demo-collab-${sessionId}`; console.log('[Landing Collab] Session ID:', sessionId, 'Doc ID:', demoDocId); // Check for step mode query parameter (?stepMode=true) const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search); const stepMode = urlParams.get('stepMode') === 'true'; if (stepMode) { console.log('[Landing Collab] Step mode enabled - click Next to advance'); } // Store reference for cleanup let demoPlayer = null; demoPlayer = new DemoPlayer({ container: document.getElementById('collab-demo-container'), demoScript: 'collabMap', // Uses collabMap demo which starts with document containing block map editorUrl: `/doc/${demoDocId}`, sessionId: sessionId, dualPhone: true, // Start with both Alice and Bob phones steps: [ { label: 'Planning', heading: 'Planning Together', text: 'Alice and Bob explore locations on the same document' }, { label: 'Exploring', heading: 'Exploring the Map', text: 'Alice pans the map to see all locations' }, { label: 'Transport', heading: 'Walking to Tivoli', text: 'Alice configures walking directions to Tivoli Gardens' }, { label: 'Route', heading: 'Route Configured', text: 'The walking route is now visible on the map' } ], autoStart: true, offlineMode: true, // No server dependency stepMode: stepMode // Manual step mode - user must click Next to advance }); // Cleanup on page unload window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => { console.log('[Landing Collab] Page unloading - destroying demo player'); if (demoPlayer) { demoPlayer.destroy(); demoPlayer = null; } });
